tools.name: codebook_start
tools.description: Prepare the declared demo asynchronously. Same key/arguments returns its original run. Poll nextActions before clicking; one active run maximum.

tools.name: codebook_action

tools.name: codebook_continue
tools.description: Continue only the current inspected pause. Copy all continueArguments from the run resource. A stale/reserved/historical pause is rejected; read state before recovery.

tools.name: codebook_stop
tools.description: Release only this run’s owned browser/debug resources. Waits for cleanup and final evidence persistence. Captured resources stay readable.

tools.name: codebook_explain
tools.description: Save labeled agent interpretation for one committed snapshot. Supply its exact TypeScript hash and declared captured value paths; server renders observed facts. Never changes understanding.

tools.name: codebook_reveal
tools.description: Reveal the exact source location bound to this snapshot while its run is active. Rejects changed source or cleanup; read its immutable source resource after stop or drift.
